title.narrative: Enabling economic and livelihoods opportunities in the Somali fisheries sector

description.narrative: The purpose of the project is to model a value chain development intervention in the Somali fisheries sector resulting into initiatives that can be further replicated and expanded into other locations across Somalia. The project will contribute to Somalia Blue Economy development ambition: working with downstream actors of the fisheries value chain, the project will directly support a selected fisheries folk community in order to facilitate their access to market-based and locally accessible high value technical and technology assistance support services (outcome 1) and working with policy makers and partners to identify, promote and support Somalia Blue Economy development and business/investment/partnerships opportunities (outcome 2). Overall, the project is expected to #Contribute towards the creation of jobs and enabling economic opportunities in the Somali Blue Economy through the promotion of inclusive and sustainable fisheries value chain development initiatives# (Objective). UNIDO will be implementing this project by working closely with a selected fisheries sector cooperative that is going to be identified and selected by UNIDO as the first activity carried out by project.
